scripts.stop: node -e "const cp=require('child_process');let out='';try{out=cp.execSync('netstat -ano | findstr :3001',{encoding:'utf8'});}catch(e){out=((e&&e.stdout)||'').toString();}const ids=[...new Set(out.split(/\r?\n/).map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(s=>s.split(/\s+/).pop()).filter(Boolean))];for(const id of ids){try{cp.execSync('taskkill /PID '+id+' /F',{stdio:'ignore'});}catch{}}"
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
